newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.

text.p: Spot millfeed values were mostly steady to higher on Friday, supported by nearby supply tightness in several U.S. Midwest locations, dealers said.
"It is extremely tight in December," a St Louis dealer said, referring to orders getting filled ahead of the Christmas and New Year's holidays.
"There is nothing going on in the forwards," he said. Some participants are worried about flour mill run times for the balance of December, he added.
Spot prices rose in parts of Carolinas, Chattanooga, Chicago-West and Kansas City, cash sources said.
"I think the buying is pretty well done," a Minneapolis dealer said. "There is not much to sell. There may be an odd truck or two that will trade here and there" due to the upcoming downtimes.
"Everybody is trying to fill in the pipeline before the end of the year," another dealer said.
